name: Lifestyle Global Enterprise Inc.
summary: Headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan, Lifestyle Global Enterprise Inc., along with its group companies, specializes in the global distribution of furniture. Their product line includes a variety of seating options like sofas and chairs, as well as other wooden and leather furnishings. Established in 1996, the company adopted its current name in June 2012, having previously operated as FuPo Electronics Corporation.
